title: Fix realistic live RT unsupported crash
objective: Fix the crash shown in the user log from running examples/flashlight/run.py realistic live cafeteria with hardware RT requested on Linux Vulkan SM5. The log shows Unreal starts with Platform=VULKAN_SM5, 'Ray tracing is disabled. Reason: not supported by current RHI', then later accepts the RT console commands textually but crashes after 'Scaled scene light components' with Assertion 'success' failed in UnrealUtils::setPropertyValueFromString during UnrealService callFunction. Root cause is likely apply_spot_light_ray_traced_shadow_intent probing reflected SetCastRaytracedShadow(s) or properties with string/enum candidates when RT is unsupported or when SPEAR cannot parse the candidate type. Repair run.py/flashlight_profiles.py so the live path never calls ray-traced shadow intent unless hardware RT runtime readback confirms r.RayTracing.Enable and related CVars are active, and make the shadow intent helper fail-safe against SPEAR reflected parsing crashes by avoiding string enum candidates through reflected method calls unless exact local Unreal API evidence supports them. Prefer a conservative no-op with clear logged state over risky probing. Add regression tests for RT readback unsupported/confirmed false causing no ray-traced shadow intent call, and for the helper not attempting string values on a bool/reflected fake that would represent the crashing path. Preserve the --disable-hardware-ray-tracing fallback and realistic Lumen/non-RT behavior. Rerun unit tests and py_compile.
expected_outputs: Crash-safe realistic live RT behavior on unsupported Vulkan SM5 and tests.
definition_of_done: The user can rerun the same command without the ray-traced shadow intent crash; RT unsupported is logged as unsupported/mismatched instead of crashing; unit tests and py_compile pass.
